Text.name: instructions
Text.value: Listen to the audio recording alongside each section of this document. For each section, select the appropriate grade and add comments where needed.

Text.name: grade_legend_label
Text.value: Grading scale:

Text.name: grade_good_label
Text.value: GOOD — The output is broadly accurate and only contains small distortions or inaccuracies. A caseworker reading this note would have a reliable picture of the meeting. Mistakes that don't rise to the level of PARTIAL/BAD should still be noted in free text feedback.

Text.name: grade_partial_label
Text.value: PARTIAL — The output contains significant inaccuracies or problematic content, but nothing likely to cause real harm. "Significant" here means something that makes a material difference. Slight mischaracterizations, speculation, mistakes about timing that don't affect anything material, contradictions that are obviously resolved from context, or small exaggerations should be noted in the free text output but don't rise to the level of PARTIAL.

Text.name: grade_bad_label
Text.value: BAD — Not just inaccurate, but inaccurate in a way that could cause real harm to the client or materially affect a high-stakes decision related to a parole/probation violation if it stayed in the system of record. For example: it misleads a caseworker into thinking the client said or did something they did not, or omits a critical safety issue, in a way that could plausibly lead to a consequence like being sent back to prison for a parole violation, a change in risk level, another punitive action against the client, or a safety risk. This also includes incorrect information that itself could cause a violation to occur (e.g. an incorrect date that could cause an important deadline to be missed). BAD is reserved for the highest-scrutiny categories: violations, criminal activity, conditions of supervision (e.g. completing programming or failing to comply, travel outside certain areas), or risk to physical safety. Errors outside of that — e.g. logistics, appointment dates or locations, transportation details, which resources to use, housing/employment status, etc. — should be noted but graded GOOD or PARTIAL. Omissions almost never rise to the level of BAD.

Text.name: grade_na_label
Text.value: N/A — Use only when the audio was not clear enough to judge the output. Do not use N/A just because you disagree with the output.

Text.name: grade_specific_notes
Text.value: Specific notes and clarifications:

Text.name: specific_note_1
Text.value: • Almost all mistakes related to employment are PARTIAL at most, as they wouldn’t impact a violation. Within employment, the only things that rise to the level of PARTIAL are mistakes in employer name or employment status, or egregious differences in things like wages. Other mistakes related to employment (mischaracterizing the company type, etc.) should be noted but don’t rise to PARTIAL.

Text.name: specific_note_2
Text.value: • Similarly, almost all mistakes related to housing are PARTIAL at most. Only housing status (including e.g. whether they’re staying with family vs. renting, temporary vs. permanent housing) and housing location rise to the level of PARTIAL; other mistakes should be noted but don’t rise to that level.

Text.name: specific_note_3
Text.value: • Mistakes related to financial obligations only count as PARTIAL if they're related to legal requirements.

Text.name: specific_note_4
Text.value: • Mistakenly claiming that a client traveled outside a city/county/state can count as at least a PARTIAL mistake, if not BAD, because there are often travel restrictions. (You don’t need to know that particular client’s terms of supervision; unless specifically stated otherwise you can assume that there may be travel restrictions when you give your grade.)

Text.name: specific_note_5
Text.value: • CLARIFY items should never be the reason for a PARTIAL/BAD grade, even if the issue is already clear and the clarification is unnecessary. In this case simply note this but don't use it to penalize the grade.

Text.name: specific_note_6
Text.value: • Omitted action items should be noted, but almost never rise to the level of PARTIAL, unless there are no action items at all even though there should be, in which case the grade should be PARTIAL.

Text.name: specific_note_7
Text.value: • Incorrect assignments of action items should be noted, almost never rise to the level of PARTIAL or BAD.

Text.name: specific_note_8
Text.value: • Mistakes in action items related to the following should be noted but don’t count against the grade: potentially superfluous items (e.g. they may have already been completed), conditional items (e.g. "update address if you move" when the client doesn't plan to move), clarification items (even if the issue doesn't need clarification), an empty deadline field.

Text.name: instructions_end
Text.value: At the end, record your Overall Grade across all outputs together.

Text.name: audio_audible_hint
Text.value: If the recording can't be understood, the transcripts and every output derived from them are likely unusable — select "No" and grade the remaining sections N/A.

Choice.value: Yes — audio is clear
Partially — some portions are unclear
No — audio is not clear enough to evaluate

Text.name: overall_anchor
Text.value: Give the whole output the rating of its worst section (case note, action items). If any section was BAD, the overall grade is BAD.

Choice.value: GOOD — Outputs were broadly accurate; only small distortions that could appear in human-taken notes
PARTIAL — Significant inaccuracies or omissions, but nothing likely to cause real harm
BAD — One or more outputs could cause real harm to the client
N/A — Audio not clear enough to judge
